subject: MVTHS Electrical Shop Profile
overview: Instructor Rich Cormier and students provided an overview of the Medford Vocational Technical High School electrical program, highlighting curriculum, licensing requirements, and career placement.

items.title: Program Overview and Licensing Path
items.summary: Instructor Rich Cormier explained how students build a foundation in residential and commercial electrical work while earning 2,150 hours toward state licensing requirements.

items.title: Student Perspectives and Project Favorites
items.summary: Students described their interests in the trades and their experiences with specific tasks like wiring, piping, and independent project design.

items.title: Skills, Safety, and Tool Instruction
items.summary: The program emphasizes the proper use of tools and comprehensive safety training, including working at heights and utilizing personal protective equipment.

items.title: School-Based Maintenance and Construction
items.summary: Upperclassmen perform real-world electrical maintenance around the campus, including installing equipment in other vocational shops to gain practical experience.

items.title: Career Readiness and Post-Graduation Employment
items.summary: Cormier detailed the program's success in preparing students for immediate entry into union and non-union jobs through co-op opportunities.
